name: Reference-Based Non-Photorealistic Radiance Fields
definition: A controllable scene stylization method that stylizes a 3D scene using radiance fields with a single stylized 2D view as a reference, propagating style faithfully to novel views with semantic correspondence.
summary: Ref-NPR stylizes 3D scenes by transferring a 2D reference image's style to a radiance field via explicit ray registration, ensuring semantic consistency across novel views.
